correctness.rationale: Over algebraically closed characteristic five and b(a²+b) nonzero, smoothness of y³=x⁴+ax²+b follows from squarefreeness and smooth point at infinity. The Cech Frobenius formula on H¹(O_C) produces H=[[0,0,0],[0,0,3b(a²+b)],[0,1,0]], independently verified by expanding F^4 symbolically over F5 and extracting all nine target coefficients. Its semilinear square has diag(0,c,c^5), c!=0; stable rank 2 gives p-rank 2, rank H=2 gives a-number 1, and the remaining height-two component is slope 1/2 twice. The involution quotient has j=0 supersingular elliptic curve, and the prime-to-5 Prym isogeny forces Prym p-rank 2, hence ordinarity. These are uniform geometric statements, not finite-fibre extrapolations.
